title: 下墙就休息
description: 成人从最低脚点轻步落垫后站稳，准备走向垫区外。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult has just stepped from the lowest oversized foothold onto the padded floor and stands upright beside the low wall, both feet supported and hands released naturally. The posture is calm, not a landing from a fall. A second adult waits beyond the mat boundary near a bench. Frame the wall base, easy descent holds, and clear path off the padding so the rest between attempts becomes the central moment. Use transparent watercolor with reserved paper light, fluid contours, a restrained indigo and warm sienna palette, and generous breathing room. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
